ev.addonWhat.ev_promos: Discount codes: % or $ off, for one event or all, with a use limit, an end date and a minimum number of tickets.
ev.addonWhat.ev_questions: Ask what you need when people order (T-shirt size, company, email…) and a name for each ticket. Answers show in orders and the Excel export.
ev.addonWhat.ev_doors: Up to 20 phones scanning at many gates at the same time.
ev.addonWhat.ev_team: Up to 50 team members instead of 3.
ev.addonWhat.ev_cashier: A cashier role that sells tickets at the gate (cash or QR) — walk-in tickets go straight in.
ev.addonWhat.ev_invites: Send free tickets to guests, sponsors and VIPs — they get a ticket link with a QR.
ev.addonWhat.ev_export: Download all guests and check-ins as a spreadsheet (Excel / CSV).
ev.addonWhat.ev_nobrand: No “Made with BizHub” on your event pages and tickets.
